evidence: ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/Activity Monitor.app/Contents/Info.plist (no document types, services or activities)

features.feature: CPU, Memory, Energy, Disk and Network tabs
features.note: Five tabs with per-tab columns and a graph card.
Click a header to sort; arrow shown in header.

features.feature: Process filters (all, mine, other users, system, active, inactive, windowed, GPU, selected)
features.note: All, Mine, Others, System, Active, Inactive, Windowed (shell window list), GPU (DRM fdinfo) and Selected (pins the selection) in the sidebar and View > Filter Processes. Windowed depends on the shell reporting the owner process of each window; GPU covers own-user processes only.
features.wire: Add System, Active, Inactive, Windowed, GPU and Selected Processes filters to model::Filter (model.rs:135 keep) and as sidebar rows in window.rs:330 plus a View menu in main.rs main_menu; windowed needs the shell window list over the app SDK, active/inactive uses recent CPU ticks.

features.apple: toolbar filter search field, Edit > Find
features.note: Toolbar search plus Process > Find Process (cmd+F) at main.rs:81.
SIGTERM / SIGKILL via toolbar and Process menu; no confirmation sheet.
features.wire: Show a confirmation sheet (Quit / Force Quit / Cancel) before signalling, as the reference does, in window.rs signal_selected.

features.note: Process > Send Signal to Process... opens a sheet with the eight signals (TERM preselected, Send/Cancel, Return/Escape); the submenu with direct items stays. Own-user processes only.
features.wire: Add a Process > Send Signal... item in main.rs:72 that opens a sheet with a signal popup (HUP, INT, KILL, TERM, USR1, USR2, STOP, CONT) and calls window.rs signal_selected(sig).

features.feature: Inspect Process window (stats, memory, open files and ports)
features.apple: ProcessInspector.nib: Memory, Statistics, Open Files and Ports tabs
features.note: Inspector sheet (cmd+I) with Memory, Statistics and Open Files and Ports segments, parent process, faults, context switches, sockets with addresses, and Copy, Sample and Reveal in Files buttons. A modal sheet, not a separate window; Reveal needs the file under the home folder to get a grant.
features.wire: Turn the inspector into its own window with Memory / Statistics / Open Files and Ports segments (inspect.rs adds parent pid, faults, context switches from /proc/<pid>/status), plus a Reveal in Files button for exe.

features.note: Process > Sample Process and the Sample toolbar button take 10 s of thread samples from /proc/<pid>/task/*/{stack,wchan}, show the aggregated report in a sheet with progress, Stop, Save... (save panel) and Copy. Reports kernel waits; user-space call graphs would need a debugger interface.
features.wire: Add Process > Sample Process: read /proc/<pid>/task/*/stack and wchan over N seconds in a new sample_proc.rs, show the text in a window with Save...

features.apple: View > Run Spindump, Run System Diagnostics
features.note: View > Run System Diagnostics... collects /proc counters, process list, disks, sockets, inhibitors, kernel log, journal tail and failed units on a thread with a progress sheet, zips them and offers the save panel. No spindump equivalent.
features.wire: Add View > Run System Diagnostics that gathers /proc snapshots, journal tail and dmesg into a tarball on the Desktop via a thread, with a progress sheet.

features.note: View > Show Deltas for Process stores a per-pid baseline; the CPU Time, Idle Wake Ups, Bytes Read and Bytes Written columns and their sort use the difference, and the footer says so.
features.wire: Store a per-pid baseline when toggled in window.rs and show counters relative to it in the table columns.

features.note: View > Columns also adds Parent PID, State, Real Mem, Private Mem, Compressed Mem, CPU Time, Idle Wake Ups, Bytes Read, Bytes Written, % GPU and Preventing Sleep (hidden by default, persisted). Ports, Kind and Purgeable have no Linux source and remain.
features.wire: Add View > Columns with checkable items per tab (Threads, PID, User, Ports, Kind, Real Mem, Private Mem, Purgeable, Compressed, CPU Time, Idle Wake Ups, Bytes Read/Written...) persisted in app prefs; model::Tab::columns filters by the set.

features.note: View > Update Frequency 1/2/5 s, persisted in app defaults.
features.wire: Add View > Update Frequency radio items (1s/2s/5s) feeding next_wake in window.rs:161; persist it.

features.apple: CPU tab footer graph, Window > CPU History
features.note: Window > CPU History (cmd+3) shows one history strip per core from /proc/stat cpuN lines; the CPU graph card lists system, user, idle, threads and processes. In a sheet, not a floating window.
features.wire: Record per-core shares in sample.rs from /proc/stat cpuN lines and add Window > CPU History opening a floating panel with one strip per core.

features.feature: Floating CPU Usage window and Keep on Top
features.apple: Window > CPU Usage, Keep CPU Windows on Top
features.note: Window > CPU Usage (cmd+2) shows per-core bars in a sheet. The app SDK has no floating, always-on-top secondary window, so Keep CPU Windows on Top is not offered.
features.wire: Add a small always-on-top window via the SDK floating-panel level showing per-core bars.

features.note: View > Dock Icon: application icon, CPU, memory, disk or network reading shown as the Dock tile badge text plus a progress bar for CPU and memory (dock_tile service, persisted). The SDK cannot draw a live graph image into the tile.
features.wire: Expose a dock badge/icon-image API in the SDK and add View > Dock Icon radio menu that renders the chosen live graph into the dock tile.

features.apple: Memory tab footer: pressure graph, app/wired/compressed, cached, swap
features.note: The Memory graph plots used memory and pressure (PSI) together and lists physical, used, cached, shared, buffers, compressed and swap as figures beside it. No wired/app-memory split exists on Linux.
features.wire: Extend sample.rs parse_meminfo to Shmem, Buffers, SwapCached and Zswap, and show the breakdown rows in the Memory graph card (draw.rs graph()).

features.apple: Energy tab: Energy Impact, average, App Nap, Preventing Sleep
features.note: Energy tab adds 12 hr Power (running mean per process name over about twelve hours) and Preventing Sleep (systemd-inhibit sleep and idle locks, read every 10 s while the tab or column is shown). App Nap has no equivalent.
features.wire: Read inhibitors from logind (systemd-inhibit --list) for a Preventing Sleep column and keep a rolling 12-hour mean per process name.

features.feature: Disk tab: bytes per process and graph
features.note: Per-process read/write bytes from /proc/<pid>/io; system rates from diskstats.

features.apple: Network tab: sent/received bytes and packets per process
features.note: Interface rows add packet totals and the card lists packets per second and data totals. Per-process traffic still needs socket accounting (sock_diag or eBPF) and is not done.
features.wire: Add per-process socket attribution (sock_diag) or at least packet counts from /proc/net/dev in model.rs:70 columns.

features.note: GPU tab with % GPU per process from DRM fdinfo engine times (own-user processes), system busy from the driver or the sum, GPU filter and Window > GPU History (cmd+4). Needs a driver that publishes fdinfo.
features.wire: Read DRM fdinfo (drm-engine-*) per process for a GPU % column and a GPU History window.

features.note: Edit > Copy (cmd+C) copies the selected row as tab-separated text, following the tab.
features.wire: Handle Edit > Copy in main.rs menu_action to put the selected row's columns as tab-separated text on the pasteboard.

features.note: Platform help book; no help viewer for system apps.
